# FinCalc.ai

An ultra-responsive suite of client-side financial and tech utility calculators processing high-intent algorithmic logic directly inside user web browsers.

## Core Operational Elements

- [/index.html](https://yourdomain.com): Main execution dashboard featuring live CoinGecko crypto conversions, loan estimators, and digital marketing calculators.
- [/faq.html](https://yourdomain.com): Public resource index addressing algorithmic computations and support routing pipelines.
- [/privacy.html](https://yourdomain.com): Google AdSense compliance declaration regarding local data non-retention.
- [/terms.html](https://yourdomain.com): Official operational usage framework and comprehensive financial liability waivers.
